name: website-hero-kit-caddy-a
refs: Image 1: the concept render to edit. Keep every pixel of it except the two areas named below.
Image 2: the genome stamp, exact. Reproduce its square cell pattern exactly, cell for cell, black on white; do not invent, simplify, rotate or mirror it.
prompt:
Edit Image 1, a product photograph of a handheld game kit on a wooden table. Change only two areas and leave everything else exactly as it is (the devices, both screens, the keys, the table, the plant, the light, the framing and the colours).

1. The wide e-ink panel on the front of the light-grey dock (left of the PRINT and FEED buttons): replace its content with a calm e-paper summary in exactly four flat greys (white paper grey, light grey, mid grey, near black), no dithering, no dots, no halftone, no gradients, matte, not backlit. Left: a small flat four-grey picture of the charcoal leaf-crested creature seen on the device screens (round body, cream belly, three green leaves drawn in mid grey). Then three lines of clean sans-serif text in near black: first line large: Pip ; second line: adult Loika, at home ; third line smaller in mid grey: 3 at home  ·  berths clear . Generous margins, thin rule under the first line, nothing else, no logo, no icons of crystals or chips. The panel sits in the scene's warm daylight from the upper left with the glass's soft reflection.

2. The paper strip coming out of the printer slot on the right: replace whatever is printed on it with one thing only, the square stamp of Image 2, printed in black thermal ink on white thermal paper, centred on the strip, about two thirds of the strip's width, following the paper's slight curl and perspective and lit by the same light (a soft shadow where the paper bends, the zigzag tear at its foot kept). No other text, no name, no number, no picture on the paper.

Photographic, the same lens and depth of field as Image 1. Do not add any words anywhere else.
